## Fire Lizard (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
 N Huge magical beast (fire)  

**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 8, flat-footed 17 (+9 natural, -2 size)  

**hp** 105 (10d10+50)  

**Fort** +12, **Ref** +7, **Will** +3  

**Immune** fire  

**Weaknesses** vulnerability to cold  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  

**Melee** bite +17 (2d6+8), 2 claws +16 (1d8+8)  

**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  

**Special Attacks** breath weapon (20 ft. cone, DC 22, 4d6 fire)  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 26, **Dex** 10, **Con** 21, **Int** 2, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 10  

**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +20; **CMD** 30 (34 vs. trip)  

**Feats** Ability Focus (breath weapon), Cleave, Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (bite), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  

**Skills** Stealth +11  
  

**Ecology**

**Environment** warm plains and underground  

**Organization** solitary or pair  

**Treasure** standard
